text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Go, Helios! Break the record this time for 
sure!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Press the buttons to the notes. Hmm... 
With so many special notes, carefully 
planning out the inputs will be crucial.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To hit all the buttons... hold with the 
right hand, trace the notes with the 
left...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Don't sweat it. Next up, Ikuno. Since you 
came all this way, want to give it a 
shot?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're doing the same song as me!? 
It's on demon difficulty, you think you're 
good~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I've got the note pattern down, and the 
song's rhythm too. Now all that's left is 
to time it and move!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Efficiently, accurately, and swiftly! 
This ties directly into management—!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's crazyyy~! Wait, no way, how did you 
pull that off!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe it's because I stayed calm and 
chose the most efficient movement. I felt 
an improvement in my decision-making. This 
could be—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It is all thanks to Trainer, who 
understands me and provides precise 
guidance."
